text:
alex: pushed a small follow-up that addresses the inline nits (split one big function, tightened var names). PTAL when you get a minute — I ran unit + integration locally. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/412
maya: thanks — skimmed the diff, looks cleaner. can you squash the fixup commits into the original? keeps the history tidy for the release branch.
sam: quick question: did you change any kernel selection logic or just refactor? want to make sure perf tests don't need a re-run.
alex: mainly refactor + renamed a helper; no kernel/logic changes. perf tests unchanged, but added one extra unit to cover edge case.
ci-bot: CI update — runs triggered: unit-tests ✅, lint ✅, integration-tests ✅ (all checks passed)
maya: nice. that CI run makes me comfortable. i'll do a full review in ~30m. if it's green and you squash, i'm fine with approving. :thumbsup:
sam: small nit on commit message: include the bug number or issue link in the squash commit title. otherwise LGTM.
alex: good call, updated the commit message and force-pushed (force-pushed to alex/412-fixnits). addressed sam's note.
maya: PTAL again — looks good now. approving.
ops-bot: Heads-up: planned canary merge window today 13:00-14:00 PDT. merges during window will be auto-promoted to canary after successful canary smoke checks.
alex: thanks — i'll merge at ~13:10 to align with the canary window. merging after maya's approval.
maya: perfect. ping me if anything flakey shows up during canary so we can rollback quickly.
alex: will do. thanks everyone! :party:
